page.notes: Τὰς is uncertain; the Greek word is hard to read at this scan resolution, so it is marked [?]. "Quarraim" is copied as printed (probably Karaim). "dubtio" is a printing error for "dubitio", left as printed. The text is one paragraph continuing from the previous page, so it has cont="true".
